strands.title: Strands Agents — Open Source AI Agent SDK for Python & TypeScript
strands.summary: Strands Agents is an open source SDK for building production agents with tools, MCP integration, model providers, guardrails, observability, and deployment paths.

selected_docs.title: Quickstart: Python
selected_docs.description: Get an AI agent running in Python in under 5 minutes. Install the SDK, configure a model provider, and build your first agent.

selected_docs.title: Using MCP Tools
selected_docs.description: Connect AI agents to any MCP server for tool access. Strands agents integrate and invoke MCP tools without custom integration code.

selected_docs.title: amazon-bedrock
selected_docs.description: Use Amazon Bedrock models in Strands agents. Configure AWS credentials, model settings, guardrails, prompt caching, and multi-modal input.

selected_docs.title: operating-agents-in-production
selected_docs.description: Deploy AI agents to production on AWS Lambda, EKS, Fargate, EC2, or Bedrock AgentCore. Monitoring, scaling, and operational best practices.

selected_docs.title: deploy_to_bedrock_agentcore
selected_docs.description: Deploy Strands agents to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime: a serverless, session-isolated platform that scales agents without managing servers.

selected_docs.title: responsible-ai
selected_docs.description: Build AI agents responsibly with Strands: least-privilege tool design, input validation, audit logging, and ethical deployment practices.

selected_docs.title: guardrails
selected_docs.description: Add safety guardrails to AI agents. Control tool permissions, validate outputs, and enforce responsible AI policies in production.

selected_docs.title: observability
selected_docs.description: Monitor AI agents with OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, and logs. Debug agent behavior and measure performance in production.

selected_docs.title: metrics
selected_docs.description: Track agent performance metrics in Strands: token usage, latency, tool call counts, and event loop cycles, all available through AgentResult.

problem_statements.title: Running more efficient trials
problem_statements.description: Most drugs fail in clinical trials. Learn from previous trials and identify patterns and strategies to design and run better trials in the future.

problem_statements.title: Repurposing opportunities
problem_statements.description: Many different drugs can hit similar targets but running trials for all drug-disease pairs is not practical. Can you identify opportunities for new applications of existing drug based on the progress of other similar drugs?

problem_statements.title: Treatment observability for patients
problem_statements.description: Help patients who are looking for more treatments understand their options. Patients with serious or rare conditions will want to know what cutting edge treatments are available in a clinical trial or maybe approved soon.

problem_statements.title: Claims Adjudication Simulator
problem_statements.description: How might we build an agent that simulates the payer-side prior-authorization/claims adjudication process — reading a prescription and a plan's coverage policy to determine and explain an approve/deny decision in real time, versus today's slow manual review.

problem_statements.title: Reducing Redundant Content Development at Scale
problem_statements.description: Pharma content starts in Regulatory Affairs (white papers, labels, FDA/EMA submissions) and flows downstream to Medical Affairs, MSLs, and Sales — each re-deriving similar content from the same source, duplicating effort and risking inconsistent messaging. Build an AI tool that ingests source content once and automatically repackages it for each downstream audience (tone, depth, format) — while keeping every output traceable back to the single approved source.

candidate_lanes.title: Running more efficient trials
candidate_lanes.fit: Use Strands tools to retrieve prior trial records, normalize endpoints, and produce pattern summaries with traceable sources.

candidate_lanes.title: Repurposing opportunities
candidate_lanes.fit: Use Bright Data or other retrieval tools to collect public drug/target/trial progress evidence, then rank opportunities with source custody.

candidate_lanes.title: Treatment observability for patients
candidate_lanes.fit: Build a patient-facing treatment option monitor that separates trial availability from medical advice.

candidate_lanes.title: Claims Adjudication Simulator
candidate_lanes.fit: Model payer policy reading as a guarded tool workflow with approve/deny rationale and citations.

candidate_lanes.title: Reducing Redundant Content Development at Scale
candidate_lanes.fit: Use Strands agents to transform approved source material into audience-specific outputs while preserving traceability.
